message.minevibe.workstation.no_room: Not enough room: a workstation needs 2 x 2 blocks and a chair in front
message.minevibe.workstation.already_pla: %s already has a desk in this world
screen.minevibe.pc.looking: Looking around (release the middle mouse button to return)
screen.minevibe.pc.hint.linux: Shift+Esc stand up · Hold middle mouse to look · Ctrl+Shift+Enter chat · Cmd acts as Ctrl
screen.minevibe.pc.hint.mac: Shift+Esc stand up · Hold middle mouse to look · Ctrl+Shift+Enter chat · Cmd acts as Cmd
screen.minevibe.pc.watch.title: Watching %s (read-only)
screen.minevibe.pc.config.title: %s · %s · %s
screen.minevibe.pc.type.tooltip: linux-slim uses less CPU and RAM; switching recreates the PC
screen.minevibe.pc.apply.tooltip: Resizing or changing the type recreates the PC; your home folder and the Vault are kept
screen.minevibe.pc.recreate.warning: Recreates the PC: changes outside /home/cua and the Vault are lost.
screen.minevibe.pc.virt.tooltip: Nested virtualization: KVM inside this PC, for QEMU and other virtual machines (M3 or newer Mac). Changing it recreates the PC. The first time, MineVibe asks before it downloads the kernel source (about 210 MB) and builds a kernel (a few minutes). Android apps do not need it: use the Android phone.
screen.minevibe.pc.android.tooltip: An Android phone next to this PC (Android 15, 4 vCPU, 4 GiB). Agents and you run apps with "android install app.apk && android open"; it shows in a window on the PC. The first time, MineVibe asks before it downloads about 0.9 GB and builds a kernel (a few minutes). Turning it off deletes its apps and data.
screen.minevibe.pc.android.unavailable: The Android phone is not available: %s
screen.minevibe.pc.android.will_start: Apply to start an Android phone next to this PC (4 vCPU and 4 GiB of the pool).
screen.minevibe.pc.android.will_delete: Apply to remove the Android phone with its apps and data.
screen.minevibe.pc.budget.memory: PC RAM pool: %s of %s GiB in use
screen.minevibe.pc.vault.added: Folder added read-only; Apply to mount it
screen.minevibe.pc.vault.rw_warning: rw: an agent can put code here that later runs on your Mac
screen.minevibe.pc.saved.recreate: Saved: the PC is being recreated
screen.minevibe.pc.done.reissue: A new workstation item is in your inventory
screen.minevibe.pc.confirm.reimage.title: Reimage %s?
screen.minevibe.pc.confirm.reimage: The system, the home folder and the Android phone's apps are reset to a fresh image. Vault folders on your Mac are not touched.
screen.minevibe.pc.confirm.decommission: The PC and its disks are deleted for good. Vault folders on your Mac are not touched.
screen.minevibe.pc.consent.title: Download needed
screen.minevibe.pc.hint.medium: Shift+Esc stand up · Middle mouse look · Ctrl+Shift+Enter chat
tooltip.minevibe.hold_shift: Hold Shift for how to use it
item.minevibe.agent_core.tooltip: The spark of an agent: wakes a CEO, or pays for a hire
item.minevibe.agent_core.tooltip.detail: Stack two copper blocks and use the core on the top one to awaken your CEO. After that, approving a hire costs one core.
block.minevibe.office_chair.tooltip: A seat for a PC desk or a meeting table
block.minevibe.office_chair.tooltip.deta: Place up to 8 around a meeting table to link them. Workstations bring their own chair.
block.minevibe.codex.tooltip.detail: Agents write notes here for each other. Right-click to browse, search and edit; every Codex block shows the same pages.
block.minevibe.wall_calendar.tooltip: The crew's calendar, on a wall
block.minevibe.wall_calendar.tooltip.det: Right-click to plan tasks, reminders and meetings for the crew, on the game clock or your real clock.
item.minevibe.calendar.tooltip: The crew's calendar, in your pocket
item.minevibe.calendar.tooltip.detail: Use it anywhere to open the Calendar: tasks, reminders and meetings.
block.minevibe.meeting_table.tooltip.det: Put office chairs around it (up to 8), then start a meeting from the Calendar.
item.minevibe.linux_workstation.tooltip: A desk with a real Linux PC
Needs 2 x 2 blocks and room for the chair. It shows a Linux PC that has no desk in this world yet (linux-1 at first), or a new one. Sit down to use it, sneak-use it for settings.
item.minevibe.mac_workstation.tooltip: A desk with a real macOS PC
item.minevibe.mac_workstation.tooltip.de: Needs 2 x 2 blocks and room for the chair. The first macOS PC asks before it downloads (about 24 GB). Sit down to use it, sneak-use it for settings.
message.minevibe.awaken.busy: An agent is already waking up
message.minevibe.awaken.done: %s is awake: your CEO. Talk with @ceo in chat.
message.minevibe.awaken.refused: Nobody woke up: %s Your Agent Core and the copper are back.
message.minevibe.awaken.offline: Nobody woke up: MineVibe's agent server is not answering. Your Agent Core and the copper are back.
message.minevibe.hire.paid: 1 Agent Core spent: %s joins the crew
message.minevibe.hire.refund: %s could not arrive: your Agent Core is back
message.minevibe.guide.hint: You start with nothing. Press [%s] to see how to awaken your first agent.
advancements.minevibe.guide.root.title: MineVibe
advancements.minevibe.guide.spark.title: Spark
advancements.minevibe.guide.spark.descri: Find an amethyst shard: amethyst geodes hide deep underground, purple inside a smooth basalt shell
advancements.minevibe.guide.heart.title: Heart of an agent
advancements.minevibe.guide.heart.descri: Craft an Agent Core: amethyst shards in the corners, redstone on the sides, a diamond in the middle and an ender pearl below
advancements.minevibe.guide.alive.title: It's alive!
advancements.minevibe.guide.alive.descri: Stack two copper blocks and use an Agent Core on the top one to awaken your CEO
advancements.minevibe.guide.desk.title: A desk job
advancements.minevibe.guide.desk.descrip: Craft a Linux Workstation (glass pane, iron, redstone, copper) and place it: your crew gets a real computer
advancements.minevibe.guide.codex.title: Shared memory
advancements.minevibe.guide.codex.descri: Craft a Codex from bookshelves, a book and quill and an amethyst shard, where agents keep notes for each other
advancements.minevibe.guide.calendar.des: Craft a calendar (a clock and paper) to plan tasks and meetings for the crew
advancements.minevibe.guide.meeting.desc: Craft a meeting table (wooden slabs on logs) and put office chairs around it
advancements.minevibe.guide.team.title: Growing the team
advancements.minevibe.guide.team.descrip: Approve a hire card from your CEO: each hire costs one Agent Core
